items.headline: Brazil Advances to Round of 16
items.body: Brazil secured a 2-1 victory over Japan in the Round of 32 at NRG Stadium on June 29, 2026. This crucial win propelled the Seleção into the knockout stages of the tournament.

items.headline: Brazil Prepares for Norway in Round of 16
items.body: Having topped Group C and then defeated Japan, Brazil is now set to face Norway in the Round of 16. The match is scheduled for July 5, 2026, at MetLife Stadium.

items.headline: Lucas Paquetá Ruled Out for Tournament
items.body: Midfielder Lucas Paquetá suffered a significant muscle injury to the back of his left thigh during Brazil's Round of 32 match against Japan. He is expected to miss the remainder of the tournament, a major blow to the squad.

items.headline: Raphinha Returns to Training
items.body: Winger Raphinha has returned to individual training after recovering from a right thigh injury that sidelined him during the group stages. While his progress is encouraging, he remains a doubt for the upcoming match against Norway.

items.headline: Neymar's Potential Return to Starting XI
items.body: Neymar, who has been recovering from a calf injury, is building up his minutes and could potentially return to the starting lineup for the Round of 16 match against Norway, especially with Paquetá's absence. He has returned to full tactical training.

items.headline: Ancelotti Rethinks Midfield After Paquetá Injury
items.body: Coach Carlo Ancelotti will need to adjust Brazil's midfield strategy following Lucas Paquetá's injury. Alternatives include deploying Danilo Santos or Gabriel Martinelli in a deeper role, or opting for a more attacking setup with four forwards, potentially featuring Neymar.
